title: Willie the Lion Smith in Newark
summary: After leaving Brown he goes to Newark, where he fills in for Willie the Lion Smith who disappears for hours.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: What about, now, this Mr. Brown's place. Is that the place where you replaced Eubie Blake.
Oh, no. That was in Kelly's.
That was before you went to Mr. Brown's place.
That was after. When you left Mr. Brown's place?

After I left Mr. Brown's place, I went to Newark. That's where I met another friend. A very good man that helped me so much. He's dead now. Willy Smith. But he was later known, (unintelligible). He gave him the title himself. Willy, 'the Lion', Smith. I used to go up there and play jobs for him. Because he -- he had a -- he worked there on the street there. In a cabaret.

But, Willy was a great pianist. But Willy, he didn't give a darn. I'd come in and he'd say, 'Hey, kid, hold me down. Play a couple of tunes for me, until I come back.' Well, he'd come back two or three hours later.
So, I had to sit there and hold it down, you know. Because I wouldn't leave as long as he was there, you know, til he come back.
Well, the man wanted to hire me. And I told them, I said, 'Hire me to play behind Willy Smith? What am I gonna play?'
